map.由刹车片新品厚度、当前厚度与月均磨损量计算剩余可用厚度与使用寿命，支持工况修正。: Computes remaining usable thickness and service life from new pad thickness, current thickness and average monthly wear, with a duty-cycle correction.
map.刹车片剩余寿命：可用厚度 = 当前厚度 − 极限厚度；月均磨损 = 基础磨损 ×: Remaining brake pad life: usable thickness = current thickness − limit thickness; monthly wear = base wear × duty factor; remaining months = usable thickness ÷ monthly wear; projected distance = remaining months × monthly distance.
map.列入下次保养更换计划: Put on the next service replacement list
map.尽快更换，避免伤盘: Replace soon to avoid rotor damage
map.立即更换，金属背板会刮伤刹车盘: Replace at once; the metal backing will score the rotor
map.厚度是直接测量值，里程只是间接推算。每次保养量四轮厚度，任一轮达极限即换，不必等: Thickness is measured directly while mileage is only an indirect estimate. Measure all four wheels at every service and replace whichever reaches the limit, without waiting for all four at once.
map.多数刹车片带金属报警片，磨损到限会发出尖锐异响；电子报警车型则点亮仪表提示。出现: Most pads carry a metal indicator that emits a piercing squeal at the limit; cars with electronic warnings light an indicator instead. Get any unusual noise checked promptly.
map.💡 前轮承担约 60%~70% 制动力，磨损通常快于后轮，更换周期不宜按同一条线: 💡 The front axle handles about 60%~70% of braking force and usually wears faster than the rear, so front and rear should not share one replacement line.

map.车主输入刹车片新品厚度、当前厚度与月均磨损量，算剩余可用厚度与使用寿命，规划更换: Owners enter new pad thickness, current thickness and monthly wear to get remaining usable thickness and service life, then plan replacement.
map.保养顾问结合剩余寿命与报警阈值，向客户说明下次保养前是否需换，避免漏保。: Service advisors combine remaining life with the warning threshold to tell customers whether pads are due before the next service, avoiding missed maintenance.
map.营运车辆按高强度工况下调寿命系数，提前安排施工保障安全。: Commercial vehicles use a lower life factor for heavy duty and schedule work early to stay safe.
map.按月均磨损算剩余寿命: Remaining life from average monthly wear
map.新品 12mm、当前 6mm、月均磨损 0.5mm；剩余可用至极限 2mm 还有: New 12mm, current 6mm, average monthly wear 0.5mm: down to the 2mm limit leaves 4mm usable, so remaining life ≈ 4÷0.5 = 8 months. For a commercial vehicle wearing 1.2mm per month that is only about 3.3 months, so schedule early.
map.厚度和里程哪个更准？: Thickness or mileage: which is more accurate?
map.厚度是直接测量、最可靠；里程只是间接推算。建议以实测厚度为准，里程仅作趋势参考。: Thickness is measured directly and most reliable; mileage is only an indirect projection. Rely on measured thickness and treat mileage as a trend reference. Measure all four wheels at each service and replace whichever wheel reaches the limit first.
map.多数乘用车摩擦材料剩余约 2–3mm 为更换线，低于此金属背板可能接触刹车盘造成: Most passenger-car pads reach the replacement line at about 2–3mm of remaining friction material; below that the metal backing can touch the rotor and cause damage. Heavy loads and frequent mountain braking call for earlier replacement instead of always running to the limit.
map.厚度为直接测量值最可靠，里程推算仅供趋势参考，任一轮到限即应更换: Thickness is measured directly and most reliable; mileage is a trend reference only, and any wheel at the limit should be replaced
